name: DB Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: DB Securities Co., Ltd. engages in investment trading, brokerage, and advisory businesses in South Korea. It is also involved in trust, collective investment, foreign exchange, insurance agencies, payment guarantee, credit granting, loan brokerage.
